baseline.note: Re-verified at the v6.8.3 -> v6.8.4 sync (4 upstream commits, merge 6a8b4c724). The SEVEN pre-existing trees are file-count IDENTICAL to the previous baseline (dtrh 1542, fyp 8, goon 184, intake 2138, player 3, tunnel 9, vendor 9), so no disposition changed. ONE TREE GREW: arcademy 88 -> 91 files, all three additions in games/impulse-control/ (casino.js, pressure.js, trickster.js) from the Impulse Control House Rules wave. THE GUARD DID NOT CATCH THE GROWTH AND COULD NOT: fileCountAtBaseline is record data rather than an assertion, and a not-ported tree has no per-tree manifest test to pin it, so a tree the port does not serve can grow by any amount with the suite green. That blind spot is filed as its own board row rather than papered over here. Previous baseline: v6.8.3 / merge fb89d087a (2026-08-22). Guard: client/tests/CcpClient.Tests/UpstreamPayloadInventoryTests.cs. A tree not listed here FAILS the suite; a listed tree that no longer exists upstream FAILS the suite.

trees.name: arcademy
trees.evidence: Copied by the linked glob in client/src/CcpClient.Desktop/CcpClient.Desktop.csproj (Content Include web/arcademy/** -> payload/arcademy); served read-only through Features/Dtrh/LoopbackServer.cs by Features/Arcademy/ArcademyParticipant.cs, whose page roots are the payload MIRROR rather than payload/arcademy because the shell borrows DTRH's spirals by relative url (shell/shell.js:76, games/the-deep-end/pressure.js:182); presence probed by Features/Arcademy/ArcademyServingRoots.Probe (typed Missing/Incomplete/Present); bytes, borrow, file count and the .svg allowlist row are pinned by ArcademyServingTests.
trees.boardRow: Port the Arcademy upstream surface, decomposed into its eight slices [P1 OPEN] - SLICES 1 AND 2 LANDED (payload serving + boot handshake; init projection + set-setting echo loop). Slices 3-8 are still open.
trees.note: New at v6.8.3, GREW at v6.8.4 (88 -> 91). Upstream Services/Arcademy/ArcademyHostService.cs and ArcademyMetaStore.cs render Resources/web/arcademy/ (a three.js campus shell: classes, ceremonies, report cards, split-flap board, keybinds, peek, audio). THE TREE IS NOW SERVED but THE SURFACE IS UNREACHABLE, and that is the ported fact rather than an unfinished one: THE DOOR IS SHUT UPSTREAM AS OF v6.8.4 - ArcademyHostService.DoorAvailable is a static readonly false (:116), the Play card ships Visibility=Collapsed (Views/Tabs/PlayTabView.xaml:1312) and is re-asserted from DoorAvailable on every repaint (MainWindow/MainWindow.PlayTab.cs:106-112), and Launch() refuses on the door BEFORE the T2 bar (:136-141). Upstream's stated reason is that Semester 1 landed ahead of its public reveal and 6.8.4 is an auth/stability patch. A HIDE, not a lockband, because a lockband advertises something the account could buy. Porting this surface VISIBLE would therefore ship a feature upstream is deliberately withholding, so the port carries the same single flag, defaulting closed: Features/Arcademy/ArcademyDoor.Available, with ArcademyLaunch.Attend refusing ahead of any allocation (no participant, no bound origin, no window) and ArcademyServingTests pinning that refusal. It also reaches the app-wide remote-media subsystem (FypOnlineCoordinator.For at ArcademyHostService.cs:1513), which is slice 7 and is NOT built: init projects remoteMediaEnabled=false and offlineMode=true, so the page opens no outbound fetch.
